body:
Photographs from the “Hutovo Blato Biodiversity” seminar, held at Motel Park in Karaotok, Bosnia and Herzegovina, on 8 March 2022, within the EXCHANGE project.

The seminar brought together tourism guides, local community representatives, academics and project partners to explore the natural heritage of Hutovo Blato Nature Park. Presentations addressed the park’s flora, fish and birdlife, alongside the Hutovo Blato Aqua Path and opportunities for sustainable rural tourism.

I joined participants in exchanging knowledge and discussing how ecological expertise can enrich visitor experiences. The gallery captures the presentations, audience and closing discussion, reflecting the connections between biodiversity, interpretation and cooperation with tourism professionals.
